crossRefs.note: They struck all the cities around Gerar; for the fear of Yahweh came on them, and they plundered all the cities; for…
They traveled, and a terror of God was on the cities that were around them, and they didn’t pursue the sons of Jacob.
The peoples have heard. They tremble. Pangs have taken hold of the inhabitants of Philistia.
She said to the men, “I know that Yahweh has given you the land, and that the fear of you has fallen upon us, and that…
For Yahweh’s eyes run back and forth throughout the whole earth, to show himself strong in the behalf of them whose…
For I will drive out nations before you and enlarge your borders; neither shall any man desire your land when you go up…
When a man’s ways please Yahweh, he makes even his enemies to be at peace with him.

people.name: Jehoshaphat
people.line: Son of Asa, king of Judah.

translations.web: The fear of Yahweh fell on all the kingdoms of the lands that were around Judah, so that they made no war against Jehoshaphat.
translations.bsb: And the dread of the LORD fell upon all the kingdoms of the lands that surrounded Judah, so that they did not make war against Jehoshaphat.
translations.kjv: And the fear of the LORD fell upon all the kingdoms of the lands that were round about Judah, so that they made no war against Jehoshaphat.
translations.asv: And the fear of Jehovah fell upon all the kingdoms of the lands that were round about Judah, so that they made no war against Jehoshaphat.
